result.title: CHSM8: A Chess Transformer that Follows Natural-Language Style Prompts
result.summary: We present CHSM8, a 210M-parameter chess transformer that plays moves conditioned on a free-text description of a playing style, e.g. "go for the Sicilian Defense", "solid, safe, risk-free chess" or "You are Magnus Carlsen in his prime". The model is pretrained without search on 1.07B filtered Lichess games, using a factorized move representation and legal-move masking. It reaches 1837 Elo against a strength-limited Stockfish and, in 1,000-game matches, beat every other public model we tested that was likewise trained without preference tuning, rewards or search, including one with 13 times as many parameters. We then fine-tune it to follow text on a synthetic dataset: Gemma-4-31B describes the playing style of 3M game sides, a 1B Gemma-3 model distilled from the 2.4M of those descriptions that contradict nothing on the board labels the rest, and every one of 30M selected game sides gets five descriptions. Supervised fine-tuning attaches a frozen text encoder through gated cross-attention, and direct preference optimization (DPO) uses the same moves under a mismatched description as the rejected sample. After DPO, style adherence rises on every prompt we test (for example, queens traded early 53% -> 67%, pawn moves 29% -> 32% of all moves, queenside castling 97.3% -> 99.7%), and strength without a prompt stays within noise of SFT (1792 vs. 1797 Elo). Design choices at every stage were made by fixed-budget automated search loops on top of standard architectures and training recipes. We document the full pipeline and the decisions behind it, report the ablations that failed, and evaluate the models across many style prompts and kinds of games, with 1,000 games per setting. The work is fully open source and reproducible: weights, datasets with all training labels, prompts, configurations, inference code and playable demos are public and free to build on.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CHSM8：一个 2.1 亿参数的国际象棋 Transformer，在 10.7 亿局过滤后的 Lichess 棋局上预训练，能按自由文本风格提示（如「走西西里防御」「稳健无风险」）落子；用合成风格描述数据做 SFT（冻结文本编码器经门控交叉注意力接入）与 DPO，并完整公开流程、失败消融与千局评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文的 DPO 把「同一走法配错配风格描述」作为负样本，可用于检验模型是否真正使用了条件信号，这一监督设计可能为 LVR 中「答案是否使用 latent 内容」与贡献分配问题提供可核查的借鉴线索，但属跨领域推测。
